ledger: 00:00 - Green olives contained in small glass measuring cup are poured into an empty large glass jar
00:01-00:03 - Dark/purple olives spontaneously appear mixed with green olives as they fall into the large glass jar (total count ~16)
00:04-00:06 - Performer scoops green olives from a side bowl into the small container
00:07-00:09 - Performer pours green olives from small container; dark/purple olives emerge during the pour and fill the jar (total count ~32)

findings.description: Green olives poured from a small container containing only green olives transform into dark/purple olives mid-pour as they enter the large jar without a visible cause or mechanism.
Green olives placed into the small container emerge as a mix of green and dark/purple olives when poured into the large glass jar.
